about: Prompts typed to Claude Code, labelled by a person by meaning, never by what work-review's patterns say. vague: Claude would have to go find out what or where before it could start. criteria: the prompt says when the work is done or how to check it. correction: it redirects or rejects what Claude just did. nudge: a bare go-ahead with no new instruction. Scored by test/work-review-classify.test.js; add a case whenever a real prompt is misjudged, with the label a person would give it. heldOut: prompts written and labelled after the patterns were last tuned, scored without tuning; they show how the patterns do on prompts they were not fitted to. Never tune against them: when you change a pattern, move them into cases and write a fresh heldOut set.
